newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu denies bid for Chilean mine.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu denies bid for Chilean mine.

text.p: Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy said on Tuesday it was not bidding for a stake in Chilean Minera Anaconda's Los Pelambres copper mine, contradicting Chilean and Finnish media reports.
"We are not planning to acquire a stake in that project... We are not looking to buy any new stakes in Chilean mines," Outokumpu spokeswoman Katarina Lybeck told Reuters by telephone.

Lybeck referred to a report in Finnish business newspaper Kauppalehti on Tuesday and also denied the paper's assertion that Outokumpu would have been trying to sell its stake in its half-owned Zaldivar copper mine in Chile.

"We are not trying to get rid of it," Lybeck said, adding that the Zaldivar mine was still in the start-up phase and that Outokumpu aims to raise the mine's copper production to 125,000 tonnes per year in 1997 from the current 75,000 tonnes.
Lybeck also noted that Outokumpu owns the Zaldivar mine jointly with Canadian mining company Placer Dome Inc.
Minera Anaconda is the mining division of Chilean Antofagasta Holdings Plc.
